BiblicalUsage: The preacher says an untimely birth is better than a man who lives long and is not buried, and Job wishes he had been as a hidden untimely birth that never saw the light.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the untimely birth is the measure of a life without hope: better never to have seen the light than to live long and die unremembered, and Job's wish is the cry of a man who has lost the reason to live.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
